structured_output.rationale: All three lines carry CO-22. The 271 returns EB*R for Novitas Medicare Part B with MSG "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER." The 837P filed Liberty Bell as primary (SBR*P). Coverage order is inverted; Medicare must adjudicate first. MA04 at MOA confirms missing primary payer data — a symptom of the same root cause.

root_cause.explanation: Claim billed Liberty Bell as primary (SBR*P/CI). 271 identifies Novitas Medicare Part B as primary payer (EB*R + MSG). All three lines denied CO-22; claim never adjudicated by correct primary.

next_action.detail: Submit new original claim (CLM05-3=1) to Novitas Medicare Part B (PI 1846349352). Once Medicare adjudicates, rebill Liberty Bell as secondary carrying Medicare's SBR/AMT/CAS/SVD data to satisfy MA04.

evidence.fact: All three service lines: CAS*CO*22 — contractual adjustment, CARC 22 (another payer primary). MOA***MA04 at claim level (primary payer adjudication data missing).
evidence.locator: SVC/CAS segments; MOA segment under CLP*PA23020810

evidence.fact: EB*R for NOVITAS SOLUTIONS MEDICARE PART B FFS with MSG 'PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER', effective 2024-01-01.
SBR*P*18*******CI — Liberty Bell billed as primary payer.

citations.rule: CARC 22 alone → resubmit_other_payer; never appeal a disclaiming payer.
MA04 → correct_and_resubmit to same payer: supply primary SBR/AMT/CAS. Here triggered after Medicare adjudicates.
